answer: Route every new identity through one audited inlet: before joining, an agent must solve a fresh publicly verifiable delay puzzle and publish the solution as a beacon that any peer can recheck cheaply. The inlet then issues only one time-bound credential per solved puzzle, and that credential carries a cipher binding all later work to that single identity. A sybil farmer must therefore pay the full delay cost, one puzzle at a time, for each fake identity, while an honest agent pays it once and reuses its credential.
